contracts.title: The Quiet Copy
contracts.description: Helix buried a clean-energy prototype. A researcher wants the original files before tomorrow's product demonstration. Find a way into their research vault. Leave the lights on.
contracts.objective: Recover the prototype from Research vault.
contracts.condition: Finish below 70% trace for +10 XP and +150 cr.
contracts.aftermath: An anonymous prototype appears on the open net. Helix's demonstration goes ahead, but the technology is no longer theirs alone.

contracts.title: Paper Trail
contracts.description: Morrow's automated debt system has been charging a neighborhood twice. Correct the ledger and its backup mirror so the change survives the next sync.
contracts.objective: Correct Research vault AND Backup mirror.
contracts.condition: Synchronize both records. Below 65% trace: +10 XP / +150 cr.
contracts.aftermath: Thousands of duplicate balances disappear. Morrow replaces a maintenance identity; its perimeter gets a little stronger.

contracts.title: Ghost in the Wire
contracts.description: Someone used Aegis infrastructure to hit a community network. Recover three signed activity records and reconstruct the route. Evidence is scattered across the system.
contracts.objective: Recover records at Dev terminal, Audit terminal, and Research vault.
contracts.condition: Collect all three records. Below 75%: +10 XP / +150 cr.
contracts.aftermath: The records link Aegis's contractor to Morrow's debt platform. Three unrelated jobs begin to look like one story.

contracts.title: Glasshouse
contracts.description: Helix's prototype was funded through a shell company. Retrieve the ownership archive. Their security team has tightened the core, but the old backup lane is still there.
contracts.objective: Recover the ownership archive from Research vault.
contracts.condition: Recover an optional archive for +15 XP. Below 65%: quiet bonus.
contracts.aftermath: The shell company belongs to Aegis. A private security contract is turning public research into private leverage.

contracts.title: Dead Drop
contracts.description: A whistleblower's account is about to be frozen. Replace the seizure order in the primary ledger and backup mirror. There is just enough time to keep them out of sight.
contracts.objective: Replace the order at Research vault AND Backup mirror.
contracts.condition: Both copies must agree. Below 70%: +10 XP / +150 cr.
contracts.aftermath: The whistleblower escapes the financial dragnet and releases a list of surveillance contracts. Aegis starts taking systems offline.

contracts.title: Last Light
contracts.description: The contracts connect at a single surveillance hub. Take control of the hub, then erase the targeting index in the vault. Give the city one quiet night.
contracts.objective: Control Security hub, then erase the index at Research vault.
contracts.condition: Disable the hub before the vault. Below 75%: quiet bonus.
contracts.aftermath: The surveillance grid goes dark. Lark opens the research, June publishes the records, and Null keeps the channels alive. You built more than a career. The planet is a little harder to own.

contracts.title: Open Secrets
contracts.description: A verified exchange contract generated from today's network conditions. Familiar infrastructure, a new layout of defenses, and payment on a clean extraction.
contracts.objective: Recover the archive from Research vault.
contracts.condition: Main objective: base XP. Optional archives: +15 XP each (max 30). Below 75%: +10 XP.
contracts.aftermath: A quiet freelance job closes. The exchange has fresh work, and the network keeps changing.

technologies.title: Basic toolkit
technologies.description: Your starting tools: scan, hack, recover data, and disconnect. Every unlocked passive is always active.

technologies.title: Wide scan
technologies.description: Scans reveal three network hops instead of two. Make a plan before making noise.

technologies.title: Blueprint
technologies.description: Start every contract with the objective and all its neighboring systems revealed.

technologies.title: Signal analysis
technologies.description: Scanning generates no trace and takes half as long.

technologies.title: Efficient hack
technologies.description: All standard hacks finish 25% faster. Hardware speed stacks with this benefit.

technologies.title: Chain hack
technologies.description: Queue up to three actions. Queue a hack on the next discovered system before the current hack finishes.

technologies.title: Selective download
technologies.description: Secure the main objective in 55% of the usual recovery time, with 30% less recovery trace.

technologies.title: Quiet tools
technologies.description: Standard hacks generate 30% less trace. A quiet route leaves room for optional files.

technologies.title: Ghost relay
technologies.description: The first relay hack in every contract generates no trace, including scanner pressure.

technologies.title: Backdoor
technologies.description: Once per contract, instantly reclaim any discovered workstation or relay without trace. This can open a new route.

technologies.title: Disrupt scanner
technologies.description: Suppress a reachable scanner for 60 seconds without first hacking it. Reusable while equipped.

technologies.title: Blackout
technologies.description: Suppress a reachable security hub for 60 seconds. Its connected defenses lose their bonus.

technologies.title: Decoy process
technologies.description: Once per contract, remove 15 trace and prevent all trace growth for 20 seconds. Activate from your loadout.

technologies.title: Passive mapping
technologies.description: Hacking a relay automatically scans three hops. Requires both Recon and Stealth roots.

technologies.title: Weak-point analysis
technologies.description: Scanned targets generate 40% less hack trace. Requires both Recon and Intrusion roots.

technologies.title: System cascade
technologies.description: Disabling or capturing the hub reduces every firewall's security by two for the rest of the contract.

technologies.title: Firewall bridge
technologies.description: Bypass a firewall in two seconds for zero trace when at least two neighboring systems are controlled. Requires an ability slot.

technologies.title: Trace buffer
technologies.description: All trace generation is reduced by another 15%. Requires both Stealth and Control roots.

lore.title: The missing appendix
lore.text: HELIX / INTERNAL REVIEW: The prototype passes every efficiency benchmark. Publication remains suspended until the licensing team establishes which improvements can be removed from the public submission.

lore.title: Lab notebook, 03:17
lore.text: Lark's lab notes: We built the first working cell from scavenged parts. The technician who fixed the cooling loop still takes two buses home. Management says affordable energy would disrupt our market position.

lore.title: A public promise
lore.text: Draft press release: Energy belongs to everyone. Revision note: Legal requests replacement of 'everyone' with 'approved commercial partners'. The original author declined to initial the change.

lore.title: Rounding errors
lore.text: MORROW / INCIDENT 441: Duplicate balances correlate exactly with the migration date. Customer support has filed nineteen matching reports. The classification remains 'individual payment dispute'.

lore.title: The second signature
lore.text: Ledger maintenance memo: Both primary and mirror require correction. An automated reconciliation job restores whichever record carries the older authorization stamp. A single correction will disappear overnight.

lore.title: A letter never sent
lore.text: Unsent message from a collections clerk: I can see the charge twice. I can see the payment once. The script tells me to say the account is accurate. I am keeping copies of everything.

lore.title: Authorized traffic
lore.text: AEGIS / SERVICE TICKET: The community network outage was recorded as authorized load testing. No request came from the network's owners. Approval originated in a Morrow procurement account.

lore.title: A borrowed key
lore.text: Audit excerpt: The same maintenance credential crossed three systems in eleven seconds. The credential belongs to an engineer whose access was revoked six months ago. Someone kept the key active.

lore.title: Someone answered
lore.text: Recovered radio transcript: NULL asked if anyone could still hear the neighborhood relay. Twelve operators answered. By dawn, the clinic and the night school were back online.

lore.title: Beneficial owners
lore.text: Ownership schedule: Helix's research subsidiary pays a holding company for exclusive deployment rights. That holding company has no staff. Its sole voting shareholder is Aegis Systems.

lore.title: The backup lane
lore.text: Retirement plan for legacy storage: Decommissioning postponed again. The backup lane carries compliance snapshots that the current board cannot delete without countersignature. Someone quietly renewed its certificate.

lore.title: An unsigned dedication
lore.text: An early prototype carries a handwritten dedication: For the people who keep the lights on. The production specification omits the inscription. The archive preserves a photograph.

lore.title: Before the freeze
lore.text: MORROW / PRIORITY ORDER: Freeze the account at 06:00, before the hearing. The attached risk assessment contains no financial analysis; it lists the whistleblower's recent contacts instead.

lore.title: Mirror instructions
lore.text: Mirror operator's instructions: Confirm the replacement order in both stores. If the signatures agree, the automated review accepts the correction before the next batch. Do not leave a contradictory copy.

lore.title: The name on the list
lore.text: The whistleblower's last draft: They have a list of everyone who asked questions. I thought leaving the company would get me off it. Now I know why the surveillance contract was worth more than the bank.

lore.title: Night shift
lore.text: AEGIS / NIGHT OPERATIONS: Operators are instructed to treat missing telemetry as hostile activity. A handwritten note underneath reads: Some people simply turn off their phones. That is still allowed.

lore.title: The targeting index
lore.text: Index schema commentary: Risk scores include association with public-interest researchers, debt appeals, and community infrastructure. The system was never looking for a crime. It was looking for connections.

lore.title: After the signal
lore.text: Buffered message from NULL: When the index goes quiet, leave the relays running. People will need those connections tomorrow. We can build something better on the wires they left behind.

lore.title: Maintenance testimony
lore.text: A Helix technician has hidden repair manuals inside routine compliance backups. The official service program charges a year's wages for the same instructions.

lore.title: An unofficial record
lore.text: An abandoned Helix test site still transmits weather readings. Local growers use the open feed to protect their crops. An engineer keeps renewing the relay budget.

lore.title: What the archive kept
lore.text: Helix's discarded patent register credits a community workshop with the original design. The attribution survived in the archive after it disappeared from the product page.

lore.title: Maintenance testimony
lore.text: Morrow's reconciliation team keeps a private tally of corrected accounts. Each entry is a household that no longer has to call the help line.

lore.title: An unofficial record
lore.text: A branch manager quietly waived fees during the outage. Central accounting demanded an explanation. The response was a photograph of the flooded street.

lore.title: What the archive kept
lore.text: An old Morrow training guide says a ledger is a promise to remember accurately. Someone has highlighted that sentence on every surviving copy.

lore.title: Maintenance testimony
lore.text: An Aegis contractor logged an objection to a surveillance request. The objection was denied, but the timestamp proves someone knew before deployment.

lore.title: An unofficial record
lore.text: Aegis lists this relay as retired. Its maintenance channel now carries volunteer dispatches, clinic appointments, and messages home.

lore.title: What the archive kept
lore.text: A security analyst left a note in the archive: Protection means giving people somewhere safe to go. It does not mean following them there.
